column2: Thuziak leh aw/video call 1:1 — phone number awm lo, key leh transcript te i device-ah.
Ghal Bol: hun tak tak ah, thup, device atanga device thuchah leh call

Ghal Bol thil neih hnuai ah a chhuak thil siam — device atanga device thuziak thup, thawn leh chhiar finfiahna, leh online te inkara aw leh video call. App hming puipui chu Ghal Bol (com.ghalbol) a ni.
Chat a tawp atanga a tawp
Thuchah te i device-ah a seal a. Thawn bawm chuan a dawn tu a finfiah hma a thuziak thup a vawng.
Call te a theih hunah LAN-ah device atanga device an inhawng, a ni loh chuan media a decrypt ngai lo coordination bridge tlem zawk hmangin.
Install tin a local cryptographic identity a siam. QR emaw link hmangin sawm rawh — phone number awm lo, social login awm lo.
Vawi khat scan rawh. Online i nih hunah inhawng rawh.
Guest chuan host QR a scan (emaw invite link a hawng). Guest chuan host public key a vawng a, a call. QR vei vei a ngai ngai lo.
https://ghalbol.com/connect/… link emaw QR chu Ghal Bol Invite atangin sem rawh.
An Ghal Bol-ah an hawng (emaw Play / Linux atangin an install hmasa).
An pahnih an thlen theih hunah chat leh call an inhawng — call tan LAN leh WAN kawng te an inpui.
Windows package te workspace pakhat atangin an siam. He site download puipui hi Linux desktop bundle a ni; Android chu Google Play-ah com.ghalbol angin a chhuak.
Ghal Bol chu Play atangin install rawh. App Links finfiah te chuan invite te a theih hunah app-ah an hawng nghal.
Release archive chu chhuah rawh, chuan ./install.sh (user tin tan) emaw ./run.sh hmunah hman turin.

Gotigin chu thil neih a ni (Technology leh hmuhchhuah inhmuhna). GOTIGIN SOFTWARE & HARDWARE PRIVATE LIMITED chu company a ni. Ghal Bol chu thuchah thil siam mar a ni; he site hi ghalbol.com a ni. Thuchah chu vawiin a chhuak a ni. Package hming leh domain te ghalbol an la ni — thu pakhat. camel-case mar dang a awm lo.
x86_64 production bundle. Archive chu chhuah la, ./install.sh (user tin tan, ~/.local-ah) emaw ./run.sh hmunah hman turin.
App dang chhungah a hawng (entirnan WhatsApp)
He browser ina siam hian Ghal Bol a hawng thei lo. Menu kha hmet la, he phek hi Chrome-ah hawng rawh, emaw app link chu copy la, Ghal Bol → Tel-ah paste rawh.
A hnuai ah Ghal Bol-ah hawng kha hmet rawh. Engmah a awm loh chuan app link chu copy la, Ghal Bol (Tel)-ah paste rawh.
Ghal Bol tan lut rawh. Thil duh zawng zawng — e-mail, Google, Microsoft, GitHub, emaw fon.
E-mail, provider emaw fon hmangin chhunzawm rawh.

E-mail emaw thuruk a dik lo.
He domain hi Firebase Auth atan phalsak a ni lo.
He luh kawng hi tun thleng hian a ṭan lo.
Tum tam lutuk. A hnuah tum leh rawh.
